headline: Claude 5.2 advances reasoning capabilities with complex problem solving
body: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, demonstrating the model's expanded ability to solve complex theoretical problems, as evidenced by its work on open physics challenges. For healthcare AI, this improvement in reasoning depth matters for clinical decision support systems that require multi-step diagnostic logic and evidence synthesis. Enhanced reasoning capabilities enable more reliable EHR integration and reduce hallucination risk in high-stakes clinical workflows. The model's progression also signals maturation in LLM reliability for regulated healthcare environments where reasoning transparency becomes increasingly important for compliance and clinical validation.
